title: A Tutorial on Cognitive Biases in Agentic AI-Driven 6G Autonomous Networks

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating agentic network slicing negotiations to compare fixed initial bandwidth proposals against randomized anchors, evaluating the impact by measuring the final agreement's distance from the anchor, latency, and energy savings.

Evaluating an unbiased collective memory module that uses an 'inflection bonus' to boost the retrieval score of past failures, measuring the ratio of retrieved successful versus failed strategies to prevent the agent from only reinforcing past successes.

Implementing a time decay factor in the agent's memory retrieval system and measuring the average age of retrieved strategies over multiple trials to evaluate the mitigation of over-reliance on recent observations.
